# T-2: Report final-regression artifacts

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Print the regression command, raw log path, elapsed-time heartbeat, and failure artifact paths from final-regression to stderr without changing artifact JSON or stdout envelope semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Start stderr includes command text before process execution.
- Start stderr includes repo-relative raw log path before process execution.
- Failure stderr includes final-regression-result.json and raw log path for every artifact-producing final-regression failure.
- Stdout remains valid JSON envelope output.
- Existing pass/fail classification and nextAction values remain unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Keep output generic and project-agnostic. Use repo-relative paths for user-visible artifact references.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests capture stderr, stdout, and artifact JSON for pass and fail paths.
